Project Manager (Web Design and Development)

The Web Design & Development Project Manager role at raushang4 E-Commerce requires organization, flexibility, proactivity, and a strategic mindset. We work with our clients on Project Teams to see their projects through to completion, collaborating with our clients to produce the best possible result. We are looking for someone experienced in Project Management that can learn our processes and take us to the next level.

What you'll do

  • Manage application & website design & development projects from onboarding to completion:
  • Manage all aspects of the project from requirements definition to post-implementation support.
  • Active management of project scope & budget.
  • Monitor & report status and progress of projects to Management
  • Serve as the main point of contact for ongoing/retainer Application maintenance & support clients.
  • Work with raushang4 E-Commerce’ management team to refine & grow the Application & Web Development Departments as it relates to managing projects.
  • Provide technical architecture leadership in relation to new project discovery, design, development, and deployment.
  • Assist in the preparation of technical information in response to proposals.
  • Lead stand-up meetings with the Design & Development teams.

What we're looking for

  • Excellent interpersonal, written & verbal communication skills to work with clients & in-house designers & developers.
  • Supremely organized and able to work under tight deadlines; time management skills are essential.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies.
  • Provide technical architecture leadership in relation to new project discovery, design, development, and deployment.
  • Solid technical understanding of application development and web technologies
  • Understanding of data structure methodologies, technologies, and standards.
  • Knowledge of User Experience & User Interaction theory.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Logical and analytical approach to critical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Good people person with a positive attitude.
  • Collaborative team player.
  • Confidence to tackle issues swiftly, professionally, & autonomously. Must work well under pressure.
  • Familiarity with project management software/ task management and time tracking systems.

Interested?

Send us your details and we'll get back to you within a few days.
